notes.title: 🌊 Tides of Tomorrow - New Game Reveal
notes.content:
[h3]Dear Community,[/h3]

We've been incredibly touched by your passion and enthusiasm. Your support means the world to us, and we're thrilled to have shared that journey with you.

Today, we're excited to unveil a new project that we've poured our hearts and souls into. It embodies the same spirit of creativity and storytelling that you've come to love from DigixArt.

[h5]We hope you will welcome and wishlist our new baby-project - Tides of Tomorrow! 🌊[/h5]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2678080/Tides_of_Tomorrow/

[h3]Watch our reveal trailer![/h3]

[previewyoutube=yVjNGNZcqHQ;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]In Tides of Tomorrow your every choice matters. A deadly plastification is slowly killing all life, and it's up to you to find a cure, explore floating platforms, and navigate through various communities. But you won’t be alone! Your friends' and other players' decisions will directly impact your story, adding a thrilling layer of unpredictability.[/i]

We hope you'll join us on this new adventure and continue to be a part of our growing community. Your feedback and support mean everything to us, and we can't wait to share more details with you soon.

[h5]Thank you for being amazing fans![/h5]

[h3]Warm regards,
DigixArt Studio[/h3]

notes.title: Lost in Harmony Coming to Nintendo Switch and PC!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31157944/279f0549490f0dd8daddd01dc44869ddca1281bc.png[/img]
 
[b]Put on Your Headphones and Embark on a Fantastic Melodious Journey to Help Kaito Save Aya[/b]

We're proud to announce that Lost in Harmony will release on [b]Nintendo Switch™[/b] and [b]PC / Steam[/b] on June 21, 2018.

Lost in Harmony is a fantastic [b]musical runner[/b] that flawlessly blends a deep and emotional story into a [b]rhythm game[/b]. This harmonious audio odyssey narrates the adventures of Kaito and Aya, two teenagers who brave many hardships and travel together across a beautiful, hand-drawn dreamworld while dodging obstacles and staying in harmony with the music.
 
Watch Lost in Harmony Nintendo Switch teaser:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AIRKJqlYFDM
Lost in Harmony Nintendo Switch and PC [b]features[/b] include:
 
- [b]Rhyme and run[/b]: Experience music in a new way with the combination of choreographed musical rhythmic tapping and running

- [b]Strong story lore[/b]: Discover the emotional and gripping story from the co-creator of Valiant Hearts

- [b]Musical experience[/b]: Moving and original soundtrack from well-known composers and singers

- [b]Hand-drawn graphics[/b]: Travel through 30+ breathtaking painted environments

- [b]Customization features[/b]: Customize your character’s clothes, hat, headphones and skateboard

To stay up to date with the [b]latest news[/b] and information regarding Lost in Harmony, please [b]visit[/b] the [b]official website[/b], [b]follow[/b] the game on the official [b]Facebook[/b] page and also [b]follow[/b] the game on [b]Twitter[/b].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31157944/55797f792380937ea0079460c627b675d5c4b535.png[/img]
